# OpenX
> OpenX provides omnichannel advertising technology for publishers, buyers, and data-driven programmatic marketplaces.

OpenX operates a supply-side platform and exchange focused on premium inventory, identity, curation, and programmatic monetization across web, mobile app, CTV, and video.

## Platform Overview
- [OpenX Home](https://www.openx.net/): Main entry point for OpenX advertising technology and marketplace solutions.
- [Publishers](https://www.openx.net/publishers/): Overview of monetization, yield, and marketplace tools for media owners.
- [Buyers](https://www.openx.net/buyers/): Overview of buying solutions, inventory access, and curated marketplace capabilities.
- [Products](https://www.openx.net/products/): Summary of OpenX platform products across exchange, ad server, and identity.
- [Resources](https://www.openx.net/resources/): Central hub for articles, reports, webinars, and educational content.
- [Company](https://www.openx.net/company/): Corporate information, leadership, values, and business background.

## Publisher Solutions
- [Supply-Side Platform](https://www.openx.net/products/supply-side-platform/): Publisher-focused SSP capabilities for yield optimization and inventory monetization.
- [OpenX Ad Server](https://www.openx.net/products/ad-server/): Ad serving tools for forecasting, trafficking, delivery, and reporting.
- [OpenAudience](https://www.openx.net/products/openaudience/): Identity and audience products supporting addressability and targeting.
- [CTV](https://www.openx.net/publishers/ctv/): Publisher solutions tailored to connected TV inventory monetization.
- [Mobile App](https://www.openx.net/publishers/mobile-app/): Monetization tools and demand access for in-app publishers.
- [Video](https://www.openx.net/publishers/video/): Video monetization capabilities for premium streaming and digital video inventory.

## Buyer Solutions
- [Curated Marketplace](https://www.openx.net/buyers/curated-marketplace/): Curated supply packages and deal-based buying across premium inventory.
- [Premium Supply](https://www.openx.net/buyers/premium-supply/): Access to scaled, high-quality omnichannel publisher inventory.
- [Identity and Audiences](https://www.openx.net/buyers/identity-and-audiences/): Audience activation and identity solutions for addressable media buying.
- [CTV for Buyers](https://www.openx.net/buyers/ctv/): Buying capabilities for connected TV inventory and audience reach.
- [Video for Buyers](https://www.openx.net/buyers/video/): Programmatic video buying across premium digital environments.
- [Retail Media](https://www.openx.net/buyers/retail-media/): Retail media and commerce-oriented buying solutions through OpenX.

## Product Pages
- [OpenX Exchange](https://www.openx.net/products/exchange/): Marketplace infrastructure for programmatic transactions across channels and formats.
- [OpenX Ad Server](https://www.openx.net/products/ad-server/): Ad serving platform for direct and programmatic campaign management.
- [OpenAudience](https://www.openx.net/products/openaudience/): Identity graph and audience products for privacy-conscious targeting.
- [OpenX Curation](https://www.openx.net/products/curation/): Tools for packaging, activating, and scaling curated inventory deals.
- [Identity Solutions](https://www.openx.net/products/identity/): Product information on identity, addressability, and signal enrichment.
- [Measurement and Optimization](https://www.openx.net/products/measurement-and-optimization/): Performance, quality, and optimization capabilities across campaigns and supply.
